entities.summary: Winston Church, a political institution in Jordan during Emirate and Kingdom of Jordan (1921–1946). Grew from Winston Churchill establishes the Emirate of Transjordan under Abdullah I. Led to the emergence of Abdullah I and Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan gains full independence.
